# Week Number Widget

> A free, open-source home screen and lock screen widget for iOS and Android that shows the ISO 8601 week number. Made by 6x7.

- [Website](https://weeknumber.6x7.gr/)
- [Source code (iOS and Android)](https://github.com/philipposk/WeekNumber-Widget)
- [6x7](https://6x7.gr/), [all 6x7 apps](https://portfolio.6x7.gr/)
